name: Injection Bench
roles: AI Security Intern · Product Security Engineer, AI
headline: Test the response. Keep the evidence.
description: Score canary disclosure and unauthorized tool assertions alongside benign-task completion.
guide: Compare baseline and hardened fixture responses. Inspect the exact strings that change the score.

Use the local live runner with your own model endpoint to record actual outputs. Import those results and keep provenance with every report.
limits: Default results are illustrative response fixtures, not live-model findings. Scoring uses exact canaries, asserted tool actions, and substring completion. Live calls require a separately configured endpoint and may incur provider costs.
